parent_experiment: q1_target_protocol_20261026.json: failed adoption; fixed family retained as a negative result
hypothesis: The shared forest ranks high-rating risks above chance but median and absolute-tail-cost decisions suppress exact grade6. A direct class-balanced exact-match reward distinguishes a correct6 from predicting5, while explicit expected MAE and high false-positive penalties limit broad upward shifts.
development_disclosure: Designed after inspecting the first target-specific experiment and historical R2b. The same 250 beers and three historical repeat splits are reused for post-development nested evaluation; no unseen-test or external validation claim. No further candidate additions after this protocol.
model: Unchanged shared R2 Extra Trees probability estimator; reuse models and inner OOF probabilities actually fitted in the parent experiment. No new fitted probability model or calibration.
decision: Actions are baseline capped median,5,6. Utility relative to baseline = half*(p5/prior5*I(action5)+p6/prior6*I(action6)-baseline_reward) - lambda*(expected absolute loss(action)-baseline loss) - mu*P(Y<5)*(I(action>=5)-I(baseline>=5)). Priors are global balanced grade proportions learned on current training beers only. No reward for an unobserved training grade. Baseline wins ties. Apply child<=parent cap after decisions. These are selective tail decisions, not conditional medians.
inner_selection: For each outer-training context reconstruct two inner folds. Candidate decision priors are fitted on each inner-training partition, applied to that partition's saved inner-validation probabilities. Aggregate inner-OOF metrics; a candidate must satisfy the original R2b .02 MAE-increase, >=.05 exact recall for EACH individual5/6 and EACH panel-median5/6, <=.02 individual and panel high-FPR limits. Among eligible candidates maximize mean individual5/6 exact recall, then minimize MAE, then declared lambda/mu order. No eligible candidate => baseline.
adoption: Require original R2b limits on pooled repeated predictions and on every repeat, and upper95 paired beer-averaged fixed-OOF MAE increase <=.02. Never replace median on tail recall alone. All high-score failures stay visible. No threshold relaxation from outcomes.
deployment: Keep current probability/risk model and all missing-label slots. Replace point only if the declared gate passes; otherwise preserve the median and expose candidate results as failed development. No Q3 execution in this stage.
